fixtures.name: hello-how-are-you
fixtures.note: The regression that prompted the probes: the leading word must survive segmentation. A transcript starting at 'o,' means the pre-roll is too short.

fixtures.name: short-yes
fixtures.note: An utterance shorter than most silence timeouts; must still commit as a turn.

fixtures.name: short-about-three
fixtures.note: A short answer with a number, the shape most likely to be clipped to nothing.

fixtures.name: mid-sentence-pause
fixtures.text: I was thinking that we could, maybe, try the other one.
fixtures.note: Contains pauses a speaker makes while thinking. A fixed silence timeout ends the turn early here; that is the failure this fixture exists to show.

fixtures.name: quiet-speech
fixtures.note: Near the detection floor. Over-aggressive gating drops this one first, which is what a caller sitting back from the microphone sounds like.

fixtures.name: room-tone-only
fixtures.note: Real room noise and no speech. Must yield NO utterance and an empty transcript: Parakeet returned 'a little bit of the three years ago' from two seconds of near-silence during the investigation that prompted this.

fixtures.name: hello-gated
fixtures.note: A real capture of the phrase after the browser's automatic gain gated it to a 0.55 s burst. Shows what capture damage looks like downstream; no synthesiser reproduces it.
